visualCharacteristics.purpose: Page crumb trail; at >= 1200px the full trail with "|" dividers, below 1200px a violet chevron plus the parent crumb only. A following hero-split / hero-split-garage adopts it into its text column

contentPattern.structure: one row, one cell holding a `<ul>` with one `<li>` per crumb — every crumb a link except the current page (plain text, last item)

notes: Existing production block (used by the migrated English pages). Companion files backfilled from the JS header comment and CSS; JS/CSS unchanged.
